S_AXI_ACLK and M_AXI_ACLK are independent clocks. Please take care of any clock-domain crossings between them. The reset is active-low.

Bridge AXI bursts between the slave and master sides. Preserve the association between requests, data, IDs, and responses through stalls, and honor the read/write and buffering options. Each channel keeps its own order. Each beat is one registered sample, valid rises on a later read clock after that sample, and valid can remain low for multiple read clocks before the next beat.
